feats.name: Artisan's Hand
text: _Tool Proficiency._ You gain proficiency with one kind of Artisan's Tools of your choice.
_Maker's Eye._ When you handle a nonmagical item for 1 minute, you learn who or what kind of craftsperson made it, how well it was made, and any hidden flaw.
_Field Repair._ With Artisan's Tools you are proficient with and 10 minutes, you can mend a broken nonmagical item or restore a damaged object to full Hit Points.

feats.name: Field Medic
text: _Bleed Control._ As a Bonus Action, you can stabilize a creature within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. It also gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
_Bedside Manner._ When you finish a Short Rest, you can tend one creature that rested with you. It regains one expended Hit Die.
_Steady Eye._ You have Advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks.

feats.name: Fortune Pool
text: _Pool of Dice._ You have a pool of d6s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You regain all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest.

_Spend Fortune._ When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet makes a D20 Test, you can expend one die and add or subtract the number rolled from the d20 result. You choose after you see the roll but before you know the outcome.

feats.name: Lyric Heart
text: _Tool Proficiency._ You gain proficiency with one Musical Instrument of your choice.

_Rousing Verse._ As a Bonus Action, you can play or sing a verse. Allies of your choice within 30 feet who can hear you add 1d4 to the next saving throw they make in the next minute. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Alehouse Fists
text: _Bar Fight._ Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 plus your Strength modifier, and you have proficiency with improvised weapons.
_Anything Goes._ Improvised weapons you wield deal an extra 1d4 damage and don't break from use.
_Iron Gut._ You have Advantage on saving throws against the Poisoned condition and against the effects of drink.

feats.name: Hardy Body
text: _Seasoned Hide._ When you finish a Long Rest, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level.
_Shake It Off._ When you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Stagecraft
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Persona._ Once per Long Rest, you can take on a role (a named identity you've prepared). For 8 hours, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks to keep up the role, and creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to see through it.

_Spotlight._ As a Bonus Action, you draw every eye. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that can see you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice anyone but you until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Trailrunner
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Surefoot._ Difficult Terrain made of natural plants, rubble, mud or snow doesn't cost you extra movement.
_Hill Hands._ You gain a Climb Speed equal to half your Speed.
_Endless Miles._ You can travel 2 extra hours each day without risking Exhaustion.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)

feats.name: Rushing Strike
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Opening Rush._ When you roll Initiative, you can move up to half your Speed before anyone acts, as long as you aren't Incapacitated. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
_Hit and Slip._ Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)

feats.name: Hearthcook
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Tool Proficiency._ You gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils.
_Stretch the Rations._ Each Ration you cook feeds two creatures for a day.

_Comfort Meal._ When you cook a meal during a rest, each creature that eats it can end the Frightened or Poisoned condition on itself and has Advantage on its next saving throw against either until it finishes a Long Rest.

feats.name: Bolt Marksman
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Braced Aim._ If you haven't moved on your turn, you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with crossbows.
_Pinning Bolt._ Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a crossbow, its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

feats.name: Bonebreaker
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Stagger._ When you hit a creature of Large size or smaller with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and the ability modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat) or be unable to take Reactions until the start of your next turn. You can use this benefit once per turn.
_Wall Breaker._ You deal double damage to objects and structures with Bludgeoning weapons, and you ignore damage thresholds.

feats.name: Parry Step
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Riposte._ When a creature within 5 feet misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack with a Finesse weapon against it.
_Measured Retreat._ After you use Riposte, you can move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feats.name: Twin Blades
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Twin Strike._ Once per turn, if you hit the same creature with two different weapons on your turn, it takes extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
_Quick Hands._ You can draw or stow two weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow one.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)

feats.name: Stalwart
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Death Defiance._ You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

_Grit._ When damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points and doesn't kill you outright, you can make a Constitution saving throw (DC 10). On a success, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Each time you use this benefit, the DC increases by 5 until you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Elemental Focus
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Attunement._ Choose one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder. You have Resistance to that damage type.
_Surge._ Once per turn, when you deal damage of that type with a spell, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
_Repeatable._ You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different damage type each time.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, a spell or mana)

feats.name: Wildtouched
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Wild Cantrips._ You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Druid or Sorcerer spell list. Your spellcasting ability for them is the ability score you increased with this feat.
_Wild Reservoir._ Once per Long Rest, you can cast one spell you know of level 1 or 2 without spending mana.

feats.name: Greatblade Master
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Sweeping Arc._ When you hit a creature with a melee weapon that has the Heavy property, you can deal damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to another creature within 5 feet of the target and within your reach.

_Overbearing Blow._ Once per turn, when you hit with a Heavy weapon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and the ability modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat) or be pushed 10 feet away from you.

feats.name: Plated Rank
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Heavy Armor Training._ You gain training with Heavy armor.
_Ranks Close._ While you wear Heavy armor and an ally within 5 feet wears Medium or Heavy armor, you both gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, medium armor training)

feats.name: Plate Bulwark
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution or Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Brace._ While you wear Heavy armor, when you take the Dodge action, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn.
_Armored Stand._ While you wear Heavy armor, you have Advantage on saving throws against effects that would push you or knock you Prone.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, heavy armor training)

feats.name: Rallying Captain
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Marching Orders._ When you roll Initiative, up to a number of allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus within 30 feet can add your ability modifier from this feat to their Initiative.

_Hold Fast._ When an ally you can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw against the Frightened or Charmed condition, you can use your Reaction to let it reroll and add your Proficiency Bonus to the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Wisdom or Charisma 13+)

feats.name: Sharp Wits
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Prepared Mind._ When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion. Until your next Long Rest, you have Advantage on checks with it.
_Perfect Recall._ You can recall anything you have read, seen or heard in the last month in perfect detail.

feats.name: Light Plating
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Armor and Shield Training._ You gain training with Light armor and Shields.
_Nimble Guard._ While you wear Light armor and wield a Shield, you can use your Reaction to gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class against one attack.

feats.name: Spellbreaker
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Disruptive Hits._ When you hit a creature with an attack, it has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration until the start of your next turn.
_Stubborn Mind._ When you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, you can succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Weapon Drill
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Martial Training._ You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.
_Practiced Form._ Choose one weapon type. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls with it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the weapon type.

feats.name: Scale Mastery
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Layered Mail._ While you wear Medium armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
_Quiet Links._ Medium armor you wear doesn't impose Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, medium armor training)

feats.name: Chain Training
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Medium Armor Training._ You gain training with Medium armor.
_Quick Hauberk._ You can don or doff Medium armor in 1 minute.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, light armor training)

feats.name: Saddle Fighter
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Lance Charge._ If your mount moves at least 20 feet in a straight line before you hit with a melee attack, the attack deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
_Steady Seat._ You can mount or dismount using only 5 feet of movement, and you have Advantage on checks and saving throws to avoid being knocked off your mount.
_Bonded Steed._ While you are mounted, your mount can use your saving throw bonuses in place of its own.

feats.name: Keen Eye
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Sharp Senses._ Choose one of Insight, Investigation or Perception. You gain proficiency in it, or Expertise if you already have proficiency.

_Spot the Flaw._ As a Bonus Action, you study a creature within 60 feet. The next attack roll an ally makes against it before the start of your next turn has a +1d6 bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Intelligence or Wisdom 13+)

feats.name: Pinpoint Strike
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Pin._ Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon that deals Piercing damage, you can pin it. Its Speed becomes 0 until it uses an Action to break free (Strength check (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and the ability modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat)).
_Armor Gap._ You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls with Piercing weapons against creatures wearing armor.

feats.name: Venomcraft
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Coat Blade._ As a Bonus Action, you coat a weapon you hold. The next time you hit with it within 1 minute, it deals an extra 1d6 Poison damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and the ability modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat) or have the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

_Brew Antivenom._ With a Poisoner's Kit and 1 hour, you can brew a number of doses equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature that drinks one has Advantage on saving throws against the Poisoned condition for 8 hours.

feats.name: Spearwarden
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Set Against Charge._ When you take the Ready action to attack with a weapon that has the Reach property, and a creature moves into your reach, the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage.

_Keep Distance._ When a creature starts its turn within your reach while you wield a Reach weapon, you can use your Reaction to make it succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and the ability modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat) or be pushed 5 feet away.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)

feats.name: Steadfast
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Second Try._ Choose the ability you increased with this feat. Once per Short Rest, when you fail a saving throw with that ability, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.
_Stout Heart._ You have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

feats.name: Rite Keeper
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Hasty Ritual._ When you cast a spell as a ritual, it takes only 1 extra minute to cast instead of 10.
_Rite of Rest._ When you finish a Long Rest, you can cast Alarm as a ritual without spending mana.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma 13+)

feats.name: Watchman
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Sound the Alarm._ As a Reaction when you see a hostile creature, you can shout a warning. Allies within 60 feet who can hear you can't be Surprised and add your Proficiency Bonus to their Initiative. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
_Unsleeping Watch._ You need only 4 hours of Long Rest, and you can remain on watch for the rest without penalty.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+)

feats.name: Dusk Touched
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Dim Sight._ You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet, or 30 feet more if you already have it.

_Dusk Veil._ As a Bonus Action, you wrap yourself in dusk for 1 minute. You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and if you are Hidden when you attack, you stay Hidden once. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Far Shot
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Extended Range._ The normal and long ranges of ranged weapons you wield increase by half.
_Steady Marksman._ If you haven't moved on your turn, the first ranged weapon attack you hit with deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Bulwark Strike
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Shield Edge._ Your Shield counts as a simple melee weapon that deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage, and you have proficiency with it. You can attack with it as part of the Attack action.
_Shield Rush._ Once per turn, when you hit with your Shield, you can push the target 5 feet away from you.

feats.name: Well Rounded
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Daily Pick._ When you finish a Long Rest, choose one skill. You gain proficiency in it until you finish your next Long Rest.
_Fill the Gap._ When you make an ability check with a skill you aren't proficient in, you can add 1d4 to the roll.

feats.name: Lurker
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Dark Cling._ You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in dim light or darkness, and you can try to hide when you are only Lightly Obscured.
_Vanishing Reaction._ When a creature misses you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to take the Hide action if you are able to.
_Quiet Soles._ Your Speed isn't reduced while you move stealthily.

feats.name: Cutting Edge
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Open Wound._ When you hit a creature with a weapon that deals Slashing damage, the target takes an extra 1d4 Slashing damage at the start of its next turn unless it uses an Action to staunch the wound.
_Opening Slash._ The first time on each turn you hit a creature that has all of its Hit Points, it takes extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Quickstep
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Step Aside._ When a creature moves within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
_Evasive Footing._ Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
_Light Feet._ Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity or Constitution 13+)

feats.name: Distant Spell
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Extended Reach._ When you cast a spell with a range of at least 10 feet, its range increases by 30 feet. A spell with a range of Touch can instead be cast at a range of 15 feet.
_Arc Over._ Your spell attack rolls ignore Half Cover.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, a spell or mana)

feats.name: Mind Shove
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Force Nudge._ Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a spell attack, you can push it 5 feet away from you.
_Long Hand._ You learn the Mage Hand cantrip. Its range increases by 30 feet, and it can lift up to 20 pounds.

feats.name: Mind Link
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Bond Mind._ As a 1-minute ritual, you can bond with one willing creature you touch. You can have up to two bonds. While within 1 mile of a bonded creature, you know its direction and general condition, and you can send it a single word or emotion.

_Shared Sight._ As a Bonus Action, you can see through a bonded creature's eyes for 1 minute, and you have the Blinded condition while you do. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Battle Mage
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Weave Strike._ When you cast a spell on your turn, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
_Focus Weapon._ You can use a weapon you are proficient with as a Spellcasting Focus.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, a spell or mana)

feats.name: Armory Expert
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Mastery._ You can use the weapon mastery property of one kind of weapon of your choice that you have proficiency with. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change which weapon you chose.
_Weapon Lore._ You can identify a weapon's properties and maker's marks on sight, and you have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks about weapons.

feats.name: Swift Footwork
text: _Fleet Stride._ Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
_Momentum._ If you moved at least 20 feet on your turn, you have a +2 bonus to your first attack roll that turn.
_Light Leap._ Your jump distances are doubled.

feats.name: Tunnel Wise
text: _Underground Instinct._ You always know how deep underground you are and which way leads to the surface, and you can't become lost in tunnels or caves.
_Rubble Reflexes._ You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws against collapses and Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from falling rock.
_Tunnel Fighter._ Squeezing through a narrow space doesn't give you Disadvantage on attack rolls.

feats.name: Polyglot
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Languages._ You learn two languages of your choice.
_Pidgin._ You can communicate simple ideas with any creature that has a language, even one you don't share.
_Quick Ear._ After you listen to a language for 1 hour, you can understand its basics, and you can learn it in a week of study.

feats.name: Cogwright Initiate
text: _Cogwright Spells._ You learn one Cogwright cantrip and one level 1 Cogwright spell. You can cast the spell once without spending mana, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
_Tool Proficiency._ You gain proficiency with one kind of Artisan's Tools of your choice.

feats.name: Warded Caster
feats.prereq: Level 4+, a spell or Pact Magic
text: _Spell Ward._ When you cast a spell of level 1 or higher using mana, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the spell's level.

_Ward Reflex._ When a creature targets you with a spell attack, you can use your Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your Armor Class against it. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, a spell or Pact Magic)

feats.name: Style Apprentice
text: _Flexible Style._ You learn one Fighting Style feat of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can swap it for a different Fighting Style feat.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, martial weapon proficiency)

feats.name: Firelock Expert
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Powder Training._ You gain proficiency with firearms.
_Quick Loader._ You ignore the Loading property of firearms. When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll with one, it jams, and clearing it takes an Action.

_Thunderclap._ When you hit with a firearm, creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and Dexterity modifier) or be Deafened until the end of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
_Avarenth._ Gunpowder is rare in the isles. Ask your DM before you take this feat.

feats.name: Spell Tinkerer
text: _Retune._ When you cast a spell using mana that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison or Thunder damage, you can spend 3 extra mana to change the damage to another of those types. You can use this benefit once per turn.
_Thrift._ Once per Short Rest, you can reduce the mana cost of a spell you cast by 5 (to a minimum of 0).
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, a spell or mana)

feats.name: Providence
text: _Lucky Lift._ When you reroll a die with your Lucky trait, you add 1d4 to the new roll.

_Share the Luck._ When an ally you can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, you can use your Reaction to let it add 1d4 to the roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Terrible Glare
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Dread Stare._ When a creature makes an attack roll against you or an ally within 10 feet, you can use your Reaction to make it succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and Constitution modifier) or have Disadvantage on the attack. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Draconic Voice._ You have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

feats.name: Scaled Hide
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Hardened Scale._ When you take Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce it by 1d6 plus your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Claws._ Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 plus your Strength modifier Slashing damage.

feats.name: Deep Sorcery
text: _Shroud._ As an Action, you create a 10-foot-radius sphere of magical darkness for 1 minute. You and creatures of your choice can see through it. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Gloom Sense._ You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks in dim light or darkness.

feats.name: Clan Grit
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Stone Stance._ As a Bonus Action, you set your feet. Until the start of your next turn, your Speed is 0, you can't be pushed, pulled or knocked Prone, and you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
_Hearth Memory._ You have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition while an ally is within 10 feet of you.

feats.name: Sure Aim
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Dead Eye._ Once per turn, when you hit with an attack roll that has Advantage, you deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
_Fey Sight._ Fog and dim light don't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Elf or Half-Elf)

feats.name: Vanish Step
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Tinker's Dodge._ When a creature larger than you attacks you, you can use your Reaction to gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class against that attack and move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Small Hide._ You can hide behind a creature that is Medium or larger.

feats.name: Glade Step
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Wild Footing._ You can move through nonmagical plants and Difficult Terrain made of them without extra movement, and you leave no tracks.
_Branch Walk._ You can walk along branches and vines as if they were solid ground.
_Glade Hide._ You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in natural surroundings.

feats.name: Emberheart
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Cinder Cloak._ As a Bonus Action, you shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 Fire damage. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Kindle._ You learn the Produce Flame cantrip. Intelligence or Charisma is its spellcasting ability (your choice when you take this feat).

feats.name: Brimstone Body
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Ashen Hide._ You have Resistance to Poison damage.
_Smoldering Rise._ When you drop to 0 Hit Points, a flash of heat erupts. Creatures within 5 feet take Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feats.name: Warband Fury
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Rally Roar._ As a Bonus Action, you roar. Allies within 30 feet who can hear you add 1d4 to the damage of the next weapon attack they hit with in the next minute. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Bloodied Fury._ While you are at or below half your Hit Point maximum, once per turn you deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus when you hit with a weapon.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Half-Orc or Orc)

feats.name: Savant
text: _Wide Reading._ You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from Arcana, History, Nature and Religion.

_Quick Reference._ When you or an ally you can see within 60 feet makes an Intelligence check, you can use your Reaction to add 1d6 to the roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Half-Elf, Half-Orc or Human)

feats.name: Last Hope
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

_Lucky Dodge._ When a creature hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, the attack misses instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest.
_Run for It._ When you drop below half your Hit Point maximum, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Low Crawler
feats.prereq: Level 4+, Dwarf or a Small species
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
_Slip Beneath._ You can move through the space of any creature that is larger than you.
_Hole Up._ You can squeeze through spaces one size smaller than you without penalty.
_Low Guard._ You have a +1 bonus to Armor Class against creatures larger than you.
feats.kind: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dwarf or a Small species)

feats.name: Greenwood Magic
text: _Greenwood Cantrip._ You learn one Druid cantrip of your choice.
_Whisper Wood._ You can cast Speak with Plants once without spending mana. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.
_Leaf Cover._ You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in woodland.

feats.name: Gift of the Many Scales
text: _Scale Sheen._ As a Bonus Action, you choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison. For 1 minute, you have Resistance to that damage type, and once per turn, when you hit with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d4 damage of that type. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Gift of the Jewel Scale
text: _Facet Flash._ When a creature you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to flash your scales. The attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus and Constitution modifier) or have the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Glint._ You learn the Light cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is its spellcasting ability (your choice when you take this feat).

feats.name: Gift of the Bright Scale
text: _Gilded Mercy._ As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature to restore 1d6 plus your Proficiency Bonus in Hit Points and end the Frightened or Poisoned condition on it. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Warm Glow._ As a Bonus Action, you can shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. Allies in the light have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.

feats.name: Unseen Combat
text: _Fight in the Dark._ You don't have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures you can't see, and being unseen by an enemy doesn't give it Advantage against you.
_Heard It Coming._ You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Blade Focus
text: _Single Edge._ While you wield a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapon, you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls with it.
_Free Hand._ You can perform the Somatic components of spells with your free hand.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Guard Step
text: _Swap Places._ As a Bonus Action, you can swap places with a willing ally within 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
_Cover Them._ While you hold a weapon or a Shield, allies within 5 feet of you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Shield Guard
text: _Ward Another._ While you wield a Shield, when an ally within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can use your Reaction to add your Shield's AC bonus to that ally's Armor Class against the attack.
_Brace Shield._ While you wield a Shield, you have Advantage on saving throws against effects that push you or knock you Prone.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Hurled Mastery
text: _Throw Anything._ You can throw any melee weapon you are proficient with as a Thrown weapon with a range of 20/60.
_Ricochet._ Once per turn, when you hit with a Thrown weapon, you can make a ranged attack against another creature within 10 feet of the target, as if the weapon bounced.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Brawler’s Grip
text: _Grip Lock._ Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can grapple it without a check.
_Hold Fast._ Creatures you have Grappled have Disadvantage on checks to escape.
feats.kind: Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature)

feats.name: Elemental Ward
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
_Chosen Resistance._ When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant or Thunder. You have Resistance to it until your next Long Rest.

_Absorb._ When you take damage of the chosen type, you can use your Reaction to regain Hit Points equal to half the damage you took. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feats.name: Stoneheart
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
_Stone Skin._ You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
_Rooted Strength._ You can't be moved or knocked Prone against your will.

feats.name: Restful Mend
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
_Mending Nap._ A Short Rest takes you only 30 minutes. When you finish one, you regain all your expended Hit Dice.
_Gentle Dawn._ When you finish a Long Rest, you can end one curse, disease or level of Exhaustion affecting you, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level.

feats.name: Quick Study
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
_Mind Library._ You gain Expertise in three skills of your choice in which you have proficiency.
_Speed Read._ You can read and copy any book or scroll in 1 hour and recall it perfectly.

feats.name: Swift Stride
text: _Ability Score Increase._ Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

_Blink Step._ As a Bonus Action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
_Never Caught._ Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

Artisan.tool: Choose one kind of Artisan’s Tools
Artisan.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), 2 Pouches, Traveler’s Clothes, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Artisan.about: You learned a trade in a workshop, sweeping floors and carrying tools before you were ever trusted with the bench. Your hands know materials the way other people know faces, and you still judge a person by the work they’ve made.
Artisan.feature: Trade Hands: In downtime your crafting earns double, and any workshop of your trade lets you use its bench for free.

trades.name: Alchemist
trades.perk: Nose for Brews: You can identify a potion or poison by smell and taste.

trades.name: Brewer
trades.perk: Good Round: A drink you brewed loosens tongues: Advantage on Persuasion with anyone who shares it with you.

trades.name: Calligrapher
trades.perk: Steady Hand: You can spot forged writing and copy any script you have seen.

trades.name: Carpenter
trades.perk: Frame Sense: You can tell whether a structure is sound, and you raise a simple shelter for up to 6 in an hour.

trades.name: Cartographer
trades.perk: Map in the Head: You recall any map or place you have studied exactly, and you keep your bearings.

trades.name: Cobbler
trades.perk: Good Soles: Boots you tend let you and up to 4 companions ignore the first 4 extra hours of a forced march.

trades.name: Cook
trades.perk: Camp Meal: Creatures who eat a meal you cook during a Short Rest can add 1d4 to one Hit Die roll that rest.

trades.name: Glassblower
trades.perk: Clear Eye: You judge glass, lenses and gems at a glance, and you blow a simple lens or vial in an hour.

trades.name: Jeweler
trades.perk: True Weight: You appraise gems and metals exactly and spot a fake on sight.

trades.name: Leatherworker
trades.perk: Hide Sense: You name any hide and the creature it came from, and you patch armour or a bag in 10 minutes.

trades.name: Mason
trades.perk: Stone Sense: You tell by sound how a wall, arch or tunnel will hold, and you find its weak point.

trades.name: Painter
trades.perk: Quick Likeness: You sketch anyone you have seen in 10 minutes well enough for others to know them, and you spot a forged painting.

trades.name: Potter
trades.perk: Fired Clay: You make jars, lamps and crude vessels in an hour, and you name the region and maker of any pot.

trades.name: Smith
trades.perk: Reforge: At a forge you restore a broken weapon or suit of armour in 1 hour.

trades.name: Tinker
trades.perk: Rig: You build or fix a small mechanism, such as a lock, hinge or trap trigger, in 10 minutes.

trades.name: Weaver
trades.perk: Fine Thread: You make or mend cloth and rope quickly, and you name the origin of any weave.

trades.name: Woodcarver
trades.perk: Whittle: You carve a simple tool or token in 10 minutes, and you name any wood and its age.

Charlatan.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Forgery Kit, Costume, Fine Clothes, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Charlatan.about: Every crowd has a pocket and you have always known which one to reach for. You learned early that a good story sells faster than a good sword, and you never lie when a half-truth will do.
Charlatan.feature: Rehearsed Lie: After a Long Rest, fix one cover story (a name, a trade, a patron). You have Advantage on Deception checks made to defend it, and you can drop it without anyone connecting it to you.

Entertainer.tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
Entertainer.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), 2 Costumes, Mirror, Perfume, Traveler’s Clothes, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Entertainer.about: You have sung, juggled and played for coins in taverns, markets and the courts of minor lords. A crowd is a living thing to you, and you can read its mood like a sailor reads the sky.
Entertainer.feature: House Draw: A night’s performance in an inn or square earns your lodging and meals, and one rumour the DM picks from the crowd.

Farmer.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Sickle, Carpenter’s Tools, Healer’s Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler’s Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Farmer.about: You grew up on the land, raising grain, animals or orchards and rising before the sun to tend them. You know weather, soil and the moods of livestock better than most folk know their own family.
Farmer.feature: Strong Back: You count as one size larger for carrying, pushing and dragging, and you can wake before dawn and read the next day’s weather from the sky.

Guard.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Guard.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Spear, Light Crossbow, 20 Bolts, Gaming Set (same as above), Hooded Lantern, Manacles, Quiver, Traveler’s Clothes, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Guard.about: You kept the peace at a gate, a warehouse or a lord’s door. You learned to spot trouble before it came through, and to tell a real threat from a drunk looking for a fight.
Guard.feature: Post Sense: After 10 minutes watching a gate, building or room, the DM tells you its best way in and its weakest watch.

Guide.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Cartographer’s Tools, Bedroll, Quiver, Tent, Traveler’s Clothes, 3 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Guide.about: You have led caravans, pilgrims and lost lords through wild country and crowded roads. You know which paths are safe and which are a trap, and where the inns that won’t rob you are.
Guide.feature: Pathfinder: Difficult terrain does not slow you or the allies following your lead, and you cannot become lost on foot.

Hermit.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Herbalism Kit, Bedroll, Book (philosophy), Lamp, Oil, Traveler’s Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Hermit.about: You lived alone for a long while, in a cave, a hut or a forgotten shrine, and came back to the world with new eyes. Silence taught you to listen, and you have learned to speak only when you have something to say.
Hermit.feature: Alone With It: Once per adventure, ask the DM one question about the history of a place where you have spent a night alone. You get a true answer if the place has one.

Merchant.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator’s Tools, 2 Pouches, Traveler’s Clothes, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Merchant.about: You bought and sold goods across the isles, arguing over prices from the docks to the great markets. You know what things are worth, and you know how to make a deal stick.
Merchant.feature: Keen Appraisal: You know the true worth of any mundane or minor item at a glance, and you buy goods for 10 percent less.

Noble.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Noble.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (same as above), Fine Clothes, Perfume, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Noble.about: You were born into a family of rank and privilege, and you learned early that a name opens more doors than a sword. You are used to having people listen when you speak, and to having them expect something in return.
Noble.feature: Well-Born Voice: Once per Long Rest, add your Proficiency Bonus to a Charisma check made to command, impress or reassure someone of lower station.

Sailor.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Navigator’s Tools, Rope, Traveler’s Clothes, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Sailor.about: You worked the decks of trading ships and fishing boats, hauling rope and reading the sky. You know the sea’s temper, and you still walk a little unsteady on dry land.
Sailor.feature: Sea Legs: You have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made on ships, rigging, docks and slick footing, and you can hold your breath twice as long.

Scribe.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Calligrapher’s Supplies, Fine Clothes, Lamp, Oil, Parchment (12 sheets), 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Scribe.about: You copied books, wrote letters and kept accounts for people who could not do it themselves. Your hand is clean, your memory for names is sharp, and you know more secrets than anyone who ever paid you.
Scribe.feature: Fair Copy: You copy any document in half the time, in a hand that passes for the original unless it is closely examined, and archives let you read their common records.

Wayfarer.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) 2 Daggers, Thieves’ Tools, Gaming Set (same as above), Bedroll, 2 Pouches, Traveler’s Clothes, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Wayfarer.about: You have travelled the roads for years with no fixed home, working for food and a bed in every town along the way. You know how to make yourself useful and how to leave before you wear out your welcome.
Wayfarer.feature: Road Debt: Once per settlement, someone you once helped on the road gives you a bed, a meal and a rumour.

Local Hero.tool: Choose one kind of Artisan’s Tools
Local Hero.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), Shovel, Iron Pot, Traveler’s Clothes, 29 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Local Hero.about: You are remembered in a village for something you did: a flood held back, a lord defied, a child saved from the wolves. The people there still ask after you when you come back, and they expect you to act like the hero they told stories about.
Local Hero.feature: Village Song: Common folk in a settlement may know your deed. Once per settlement, one of them will guide you, hide you for a night, or carry a message to the next village.

Guild Artisan.tool: Choose one kind of Artisan’s Tools
Guild Artisan.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), Letter of Introduction from Your Guild, Traveler’s Clothes, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Guild Artisan.about: You belong to a craft guild in one of the cities, with dues paid, rules kept and a reputation to protect. Your guild is your family and your insurance, and it expects you to hold its name with pride.
Guild Artisan.feature: Guild Letter: You carry a sealed letter from your guild. At any chapter it sells what you craft at full list price instead of half, houses you for a night, and lends you a workbench.

Wildlander.tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
Wildlander.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Hunting Trap, Animal Trophy, Bedroll, 5 days of Rations, Waterskin, Traveler’s Clothes, 38 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Wildlander.about: You were raised far from the towns, in the marshes, hills or open country where survival is a daily job. You trust your own judgement more than laws and lords, and you never feel more at home than under the open sky.
Wildlander.feature: Wild Kin: Beasts with an Intelligence of 2 or less do not attack you unless provoked or starving, and you can calm a frightened or wounded beast without a check.

City Dreg.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Dagger, Map, Disguise Kit, Token of Your Parents, Traveler’s Clothes, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
City Dreg.about: You grew up in the streets, sleeping in doorways and stealing bread before you could read. The city taught you to watch, to run and to keep your secrets close, and you still find yourself counting exits in any room.
City Dreg.feature: Gutter Network: Street children and beggars in any city pass you news for a coin and will hide you for a night.

City Watch.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
City Watch.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Light Crossbow, 20 Bolts, Spear, Manacles, Signal Whistle, Watch Uniform, Gaming Set (same as above), 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
City Watch.about: You patrolled the streets of a walled city, keeping the peace, chasing thieves and dragging drunks home. You know the town better than most people who live in it, and you know the quiet deals that keep it running.
City Watch.feature: Beat Knowledge: In a walled city you can tell the DM which gate, patrol route or watch house suits what you need, and the watch there treats you as a colleague.

Clan Crafter.tool: Choose one kind of Artisan’s Tools
Clan Crafter.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan’s Tools (same as above), Maker’s Mark Chisel, Pouch, Traveler’s Clothes, 31 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Clan Crafter.about: You were raised in a clan of crafters, where every child learns a trade and every trade is handed down through blood and tradition. The clan’s workshops are your first home, and their name is the only one that opens the right doors.
Clan Crafter.feature: Maker’s Mark: Anything you craft carries your clan’s mark. Folk who know it pay 10 percent more, and a marked weapon or armour cannot be broken by nonmagical means.

Arrogant Scholar.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Quarterstaff, Calligrapher’s Supplies, Book (history), Parchment (8 sheets), Robe, 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Arrogant Scholar.about: You spent your youth in a library, a monastery or a university, reading everything you could reach and arguing with the masters who taught you. You know the old texts well, and you are shy when the world does not come to you through a book.
Arrogant Scholar.feature: Well, Actually: Once per Short Rest, when you see a creature, ask the DM what it is resistant, vulnerable and immune to. You say it aloud, and everyone nearby is annoyed.

Courtier.tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
Courtier.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), Fine Clothes, Perfume, Pouch, 20 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Courtier.about: You lived in the halls of a lord or king, learning the rules of who speaks, who listens and who smiles while they plot. You can carry a conversation through three rooms of enemies, and you still keep a list of favours owed.
Courtier.feature: Read the Room: After 1 minute of conversation with someone, the DM tells you one thing they want and one thing they fear. Once per Long Rest.

Faction Agent.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Disguise Kit, Faction Badge, Ink, Paper (5 sheets), Traveler’s Clothes, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Faction Agent.about: You work for one of the factions or houses that run the isles, carrying messages, making deals and finding the things their enemies would rather keep hidden. You are loyal to your house, but you are never sure which of your fellows will sell you out.
Faction Agent.feature: Courier Call: You and allies who learn your cipher can write messages no one else can read. Once per Long Rest, your faction sends a courier within a day to carry a message or bring a small item (worth up to 50 GP).

Stranger from Afar.tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
Stranger from Afar.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), 2 Maps of Your Homeland, Jewellery from Home, Backpack, Bedroll, 5 days of Rations, Waterskin, Traveler’s Clothes, 25 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Stranger from Afar.about: You come from across the sea, from a land far beyond the empire, and you have the marks of that journey in your speech and your habits. The isles see you as a curiosity, but your home holds memories and knowledge that few here have seen.
Stranger from Afar.feature: Foreign Eye: You notice what locals take for granted, and you have Advantage on Insight and Investigation checks about local customs, hidden rules and secrets.

Inheritor.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Inheritor.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (same as above), Book (family history), Fine Clothes, Pouch, 9 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Inheritor.about: You were left a legacy you did not ask for: a house, a debt, a grudge or an oath passed down from someone who died too soon. You are still learning what it means to be the one who carries it.
Inheritor.feature: Heirloom: You carry a family heirloom with a minor magic, chosen with the DM: it casts Light, Mending or Prestidigitation at will, and once per adventure it opens a door in the story.

Knight of an Order.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Knight of an Order.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (same as above), Signet or Banner, Holy Symbol (Emblem), Fine Clothes, 24 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Knight of an Order.about: You were trained in one of the knightly orders, an oath sworn before a shrine and kept through every hardship. The order gave you armour, a horse and a purpose, and it expects you to remember both.
Knight of an Order.feature: Chapter Shelter: Your order houses and feeds you in its keeps, and once per season its knights will vouch for you at court.

Mercenary Veteran.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Mercenary Veteran.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Shortsword, Light Crossbow, 20 Bolts, Gaming Set (same as above), Company Insignia, Traveler’s Clothes, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Mercenary Veteran.about: You have fought for coin in too many wars and sold your sword to too many banners. You know the price of a life and the value of a good contract, and you keep old friends from the company you cannot easily forget.
Mercenary Veteran.feature: Old Contract: Once per Long Rest in a settlement, you can hire a Guard (stat block) for a day at standard rates. They will not walk into obvious death.

Bounty Hunter.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Thieves’ Tools, 2 Manacles, Net, Rope, Dagger, Traveler’s Clothes, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Bounty Hunter.about: You hunt people for money in the cities, tracking debtors, deserters and fugitives who thought they had got away. You know the law well enough to bend it, and you have learned that a live prisoner pays better than a dead one.
Bounty Hunter.feature: Mark Your Quarry: As a Bonus Action, mark a creature you can see. For 24 hours you know its direction and distance, and you have Advantage on Survival checks to track it. Once per Short Rest.

Haunted.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Herbalism Kit, Holy Water, Holy Symbol (Amulet), 5 Torches, Traveler’s Clothes, 13 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Haunted.about: Something terrible happened to you once, in the dark where you did not expect it, and it has never fully let go. You keep the memory close, and you have learned to read the signs of the unnatural before others can.
Haunted.feature: Dread Sense: When a place or person within 30 feet is touched by death, madness or the fiendish, you feel it as a chill. The DM tells you which.

Investigator.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Disguise Kit, Bullseye Lantern, Paper (5 sheets), Ink Pen, Traveler’s Clothes, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Investigator.about: You solve crimes for a living, for a city, a lord or a private client who cannot trust the watch. You are patient, observant and suspicious of every story, and you have learned to find the truth in the gaps between what people say.
Investigator.feature: Scene Read: After 1 minute examining a scene, ask the DM one question about what happened there or what has been moved. You get a true answer.

Pirate.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator’s Tools, Club (belaying pin), Dagger, Rope, Lucky Charm, Traveler’s Clothes, 19 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Pirate.about: You sailed under a black flag or a letter of marque, taking ships and sacking ports for gold and glory. You know the ocean’s dark corners and the harbours that do not ask questions, and you still wonder whether the sea will ever forgive you.
Pirate.feature: Black Flag Harbour: In most port towns you can find a hidden harbour or a fence, and pirate crews will shelter you and trade rumours if you pay your share.

Spy.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Thieves’ Tools, Crowbar, Dagger, Gaming Set (same as above), Traveler’s Clothes, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Spy.about: You worked in the shadows for a house, a kingdom or a guild, gathering secrets and passing them to the people who paid for them. You are good at being unseen, and you have learned to trust no one who has not earned it.
Spy.feature: Lip Reader: You can read lips in any language you know, and you have Advantage on checks to overhear a conversation or hide while listening. Once per Long Rest you can mimic a voice you have heard for 1 minute.

Gladiator.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Gladiator.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Disguise Kit, Trident, Net, Costume, Admirer’s Favour, 14 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Gladiator.about: You fought in the arenas for crowds and purses, a name in the sand and a bloody rope tied to your wrist. The fans remember your fights, and so do the men you beat, and both have their own use.
Gladiator.feature: Arena Name: Wherever fights are held, the ring master will pay you to fight or train, and the crowd will sometimes forgive a brawl.

Knight.tool: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
Knight.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Gaming Set (same as above), Fine Clothes, Signet Ring, Scroll of Pedigree, 28 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Knight.about: You were raised as a knight of a lord, sworn to a banner and an oath of service. You learned to ride, to fight and to speak to nobles, and you still keep the oath when it is hard to keep.
Knight.feature: Squire and Colours: A squire (commoner) follows you, carries your gear and, once per Long Rest, hands you a weapon, shield or item without costing your action. A lord vouches for you at court.

Shipwright.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Carpenter’s Tools, Light Hammer, Rope, Block and Tackle, Hooded Lantern, Traveler’s Clothes, 31 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Shipwright.about: You built and repaired ships in a yard along the coast, shaping timber and tar into things that float. You know how a hull fails and how to make it last, and you judge a crew by the state of its boat.
Shipwright.feature: Yard Knowledge: Any yard lends you a dock and tools, and you can judge a vessel’s condition at a glance.

Smuggler.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator’s Tools, Rope, Hooded Lantern, Backpack, Pouch, Traveler’s Clothes, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Smuggler.about: You moved goods past the customs houses and the watch, running cargo in the dark on fast boats and hidden carts. You know the coves, the tides and the men who will look the other way for the right price.
Smuggler.feature: False Bottom: You can hide a Small item on your person or in cargo so that searches miss it unless the searcher beats a DC of 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Wisdom modifier.

Archaeologist.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Cartographer’s Tools, Map or Scroll Case, Hooded Lantern, Shovel, Tent, Miner’s Pick, Trinket from a Dig, 22 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Archaeologist.about: You dug through ruins, tombs and forgotten cities, looking for the lost things of the old world. You are careful with what you find, and you have learned that some of it is better left buried.
Archaeologist.feature: Delver’s Instinct: You have Advantage on Investigation checks to find traps and hidden doors, and on saving throws against traps.

Fey Stray.tool: Choose one kind of Musical Instrument
Fey Stray.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Musical Instrument (same as above), 3 Trinkets from the Fey Realm, Sprig of Mistletoe, Bedroll, 5 days of Rations, Waterskin, Traveler’s Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Fey Stray.about: You were taken into the fey woods as a child, or walked into them once and came out changed. You remember the world on the other side in dreams, and you still notice when the fey are watching.
Fey Stray.feature: Fey Notice: You can tell when a fey creature is near or a bargain was struck in the woods, and once a season you can find a fey creature willing to hear you.

Dishonored Orc.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Smith’s Tools, Handaxe, Broken Clan Token, Traveler’s Clothes, 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Dishonored Orc.about: You were blooded once, and then you weren't. Whatever you did, or were said to have done, cost you your clan's name and your tusks, and every orc who sees the filed stumps knows it. You learned to hunt alone, mend your own gear and keep walking, and you are still deciding whether to prove them wrong or stop caring.
Dishonored Orc.feature: Marked: Any orc who sees your filed tusks knows you were unblooded, so clan hospitality is closed to you. In return you owe no clan anything, and an orc who respects a fight will still hear you out in a challenge.

Black Lizardfolk.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Herbalism Kit, Spear, Bone Charm, Traveler’s Clothes, 21 GP; or (B) 50 GP
Black Lizardfolk.about: You hatched black-scaled, one of the Bonecrown’s own children, and the hunters drove you out before your scales hardened. You grew up on the edge of other people’s marshes, learning to hide, forage and trust no tribe, and you carry a king’s blood that no lizardfolk will name.
Black Lizardfolk.feature: Outcast Royal: Lizardfolk know your black scales on sight and will not take you in, but none of them dares harm you openly. Other scaled folk and hermits of the wild treat you as someone with a story, and may hear you out.

Tinkering.name: Brawn Springs
text: Armor fitted with tensioned springs. Add your Intelligence modifier to Strength checks and saves, and a few times per day you can refuse to be knocked prone.

Tinkering.name: Backstep Gears
text: Boots with a ticking heel-wheel that remembers your steps. As a bonus action, snap back to a spot you stood on since your last turn, up to 15 feet away.

Tinkering.name: Tuned Focus
text: A rod, staff or wand with a brass tuning coil. +1 to spell attack rolls, and your spells ignore half cover. +2 at 10th level.

Tinkering.name: Riveted Guard
text: Armor or a shield with clockwork plating. +1 AC (+2 at 10th level).

Tinkering.name: Balanced Blade
text: A simple or martial weapon with a weighted gear in the hilt becomes a +1 weapon (+2 at 10th level).

Tinkering.name: Ticking Helm
text: A helmet with a quiet alarm-spring. You have advantage on initiative and can't be surprised while awake.

Tinkering.name: Brass Familiar
text: A tiny clockwork creature, a beetle, finch or rat, that obeys you, scouts, fights beside you, and can deliver your touch spells.

Tinkering.name: Steadying Weights
text: Armor or robes with a gyroscope sewn in. A few times per day, turn a failed concentration save into a success.

Tinkering.name: Lantern Blade
text: A +1 weapon with a shuttered lamp in the guard. It sheds light on command, and as a reaction a few times per day it flashes to blind a creature that hits you.

Tinkering.name: Self-Loading Crossbow
text: A ranged weapon with a winding magazine. It becomes +1, ignores the loading property, and forges its own bolts or bullets.

Tinkering.name: Guild Pattern
text: Build a common or uncommon magic item from the Guild's pattern books, such as a bag of holding, goggles of night or a rope of climbing, with finer patterns at higher levels.

Tinkering.name: Spring Shield
text: A +1 shield with a coiled ram. As a reaction a few times per day, it punches an attacker 15 feet away.

Tinkering.name: Insulated Plating
text: Armor lined with treated copper. Resistance to one damage type: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder.

Tinkering.name: Recoil Chain
text: A thrown weapon with a retracting chain becomes +1 and snaps back to your hand after the attack.

Tinkering.name: Mana Coil
text: A ring with a wound copper coil. Once per day, it gives back the mana of a spell of 3rd level or lower (up to 18 mana).

Tinkering.name: Piston Armor
text: Armor with leg pistons and powered gauntlets: +5 feet of speed, gauntlets that strike for 1d8 force and can be thrown 20/60 feet and return, and clockwork that replaces missing limbs.
